title: Hinted Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2611.02270v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling laws predict the outcome of large, expensive training runs by extrapolating trends from smaller, cheaper runs. On downstream accuracy evaluations, these predictions fail when the weaker models produced by the cheaper runs score near zero accuracy, because these scores give no trend to extrapolate to larger scales. We introduce hinted scaling laws, which use privileged information to turn a benchmark into a continuum of easier versions so that even the small models score above zero. We find that accuracy rises smoothly and predictably with the hint level, enabling new types of scaling laws that operate below the noise threshold. On the Delphi pretraining ladder, a hinted scaling law fit on models trained with at most $10^{20}$ FLOPs forecasts the GSM8K accuracy of a $10^{23}$ FLOP model (25.9%) to within 3 percentage points; a standard scaling law under-forecasts it by 13 percentage points when fit on the same models and by 12 e

translated_abstract: 缩放定律通过从更小、更便宜的训练运行中外推趋势，来预测大型、昂贵训练运行的结果。在下游准确率评估中，当较便宜运行所产生的较弱模型的准确率接近零时，这些预测便会失效，因为这些分数无法提供可外推到更大规模的趋势。我们提出了提示式缩放定律，它利用特权信息将一个基准转换为难度连续递减的一系列简化版本，使得即使是小模型也能取得高于零的分数。我们发现准确率随提示水平平滑且可预测地上升，从而催生了能够在噪声阈值以下运作的新型缩放定律。在 Delphi 预训练阶梯上，用训练计算量至多 $10^{20}$ FLOPs 的模型拟合的提示式缩放定律，对一个 $10^{23}$ FLOP 模型的 GSM8K 准确率（25.9%）的预测误差在 3 个百分点以内；而在相同模型上拟合的标准缩放定律则低估了 13 个百分点（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提示式缩放定律利用特权信息将基准测试转化为难度连续的简化版本，让小模型也能获得非零分数，从而在噪声阈值以下实现平滑可预测的缩放外推，将 $10^{23}$ FLOP 大模型 GSM8K 准确率的预测误差控制在 3 个百分点以内，远优于标准缩放定律的 13 个百分点误差。
en_tdlr: Hinted scaling laws use privileged information to turn benchmarks into a continuum of easier versions so that even small models score above zero, enabling new scaling laws that work below the noise threshold and forecast a $10^{23}$ FLOP model's GSM8K accuracy to within 3 percentage points.
